    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.exists_basic_summand_coordinates {R : Type u} [Ring R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (k : Type u) [Field k] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] (P : TwoTerm R) {l : List (HomotopyCategory (FGModuleCat R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))} (hl : P.BasicDecomposition l) :
    ∃ (v : Fin l.length → ProjectiveClass R), ∀ (X : TwoTerm R), IsInAdd X.asArrow P.asArrow → X.projectiveClass ∈ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range v)

    The classes of all strict summands in add(P) lie in a subgroup generated by at most one class for each member of a basic homotopy decomposition.
